prompt: The N-Queens puzzle requires placing 7 non-attacking queens on a 7 x 7 chessboard. Using backtracking with column and diagonal constraint sets, how many distinct valid queen configurations exist for N = 7?
explanation: For an 7 x 7 board, row-by-row backtracking with pruning across columns and diagonals (row-col and row+col) finds exactly 40 distinct solution(s).
